_about: Which schema fields play a role the content rules care about (studio/PHASE1-DESIGN.md 8.3). Keys are 'file:field' (file 'pages' stands for every page) or '*:field'. Roles: seoTitle, seoDescription, socialDescription (length rules), heading (duplicate headings in one list), label (a link or button label: judged next to its address), body, ignore (named like a role but no rule applies). Alt text pairs and link addresses are derived from the schema, not listed here. check-content-rules fails when a schema field with one of these names is not mapped, so a new field cannot silently escape the rules.
